john1.3.p1.b1.text: Behold what manner of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God. And that is what we are!

john1.3.p1.b2.text: Beloved, we are now children of God, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. We know that when Christ appears, we will be like Him, …

john1.3.p1.b3.text: And everyone who has this hope in Him purifies himself, just as Christ is pure.

john1.3.p2.b1.text: But you know that Christ appeared to take away sins, and in Him there is no sin.

john1.3.p2.b2.text: Little children, let no one deceive you: The one who practices righteousness is righteous, just as Christ is righteous.

john1.3.p2.b3.text: … Anyone who does not practice righteousness is not of God, nor is anyone who does not love his brother.

john1.3.p3.b1.text: This is the message you have heard from the beginning: We should love one another.

john1.3.p3.b2.text: Do not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and murdered his brother. …

john1.3.p3.b3.text: … The one who does not love remains in death.

john1.3.p4.b1.text: By this we know what love is: Jesus laid down His life for us, and we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers.

john1.3.p4.b2.text: If anyone with earthly possessions sees his brother in need, but withholds his compassion from him, how can the love of God abide in him?

john1.3.p4.b3.text: Little children, let us love not in word and speech, but in action and truth.

john1.3.p5.b1.text: Even if our hearts condemn us, God is greater than our hearts, and He knows all things.

john1.3.p5.b2.text: Beloved, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God,

john1.3.p5.b3.text: And this is His commandment: that we should believe in the name of His Son, Jesus Christ, and we should love one another just as He commanded us.

john1.3.p5.b4.text: … And by this we know that He remains in us: by the Spirit He has given us.
